finalEdits.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Input image is the edit target. Preserve the complete object exactly: its shape, camera angle, detail, colors and size. Remove ONLY the broad golden glow/aura and all backdrop outside the object, including glow around the top and sides and colored haze inside the open spaces. Replace removed surroundings with true fully transparent alpha. Keep clean natural object edges and at most a tiny neutral soft contact shadow immediately at the feet/base. No new scenery, no cropping, no glow, no changes to object design. This must be a usable isolated game sprite with an entirely transparent background.

prompts.bench: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one complete independent transparent isometric RPG scenery sprite for the game Gouden Horizon. Style: detailed painterly storybook fantasy, warm pale sandstone, aged brass, rich moss-green accents, warm sunlight from upper left; fixed 30-degree isometric camera looking down, consistent with a golden greenhouse city. Composition: entire SINGLE object, centered, isolated with generous transparent margins, no cropping. Readable silhouette and material texture at small game size. True transparent alpha, clean edges, minimal soft contact shadow confined to the base. No surrounding scene, pavement, characters, text, labels, multiple views or baked checkerboard. Subject: one elegant park bench, honey-brown wooden seat and back slats, two ornate weathered brass side frames with restrained botanical scrollwork. Seat aligned along an isometric diagonal left-to-right; both feet and their contact points clearly visible. No plants on or behind bench.
